text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems I've injured myself. I can only apologize. I accept full responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know my own body. I felt my limits approaching.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And yet I failed to stop myself in time. I blithely regarded them as a challenge.
choice_data_list: Let's slow things down for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite. Rest assured, I am contrite. If I wish to conquer myself, first, I must know myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And I must learn to walk before I can run. I will bear that lesson firmly in mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will rise to any challenge that my imperial calling demands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But for now, I remain constrained. And I admit, frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah. I always end up showing you my worst side, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How am I ever to overcome my limits with a heart so frail?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, while I cannot train my body for a while, I can train my mind as I please!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have opened my eyes, Trainer. I owe you a debt!
